title: Autonaut Future Fund
summary: Support for the educational journeys of our builders’ children.
body: Building a future includes the people you’re building it for. The Autonaut Future Fund supports employees’ children in their education, with a scholarship programme run through the Autonaut Foundation.
details: A programme designed around the next generation’s opportunities
note: Eligibility, application windows and grant details are confirmed by the People team.
source: Starter Kit 26, page 22; Slack announcements, 11 November 2024

photos.alt: Children taking part in an Autonaut Future Fund activity
An adult helping a child at an Autonaut Future Fund activity

title: CareHer
eyebrow: Care for her. Care for her career.
summary: Support for women through different stages of life and work.
body: CareHer was developed with women at Cars24. It brings support around maternity and the return to work into the conversation about a long-term career.
details: Support through maternity and the transition back to work
A People contact to help navigate the journey
note: Your People partner can explain the current policy, eligibility and support available to you.

title: Health
summary: Health check-ups and camps that bring care closer to the workplace.
body: Health check-ups and workplace camps bring care closer to the work. Our in-house Wellness team helps builders make room for their physical health.
details: Support from the in-house Wellness team
note: Availability and schedules vary. Check with your People partner for your location.

title: Wellbeing
summary: Space for wellbeing, honest conversations and support when you need it.
body: Our in-house Wellness team offers counselling and supports physical wellbeing through fitness initiatives. Open feedback and honest conversations are part of how we support one another.
note: Ask the People team which services and facilities are available for your role and location.

title: Compassionate Support
eyebrow: When life asks more of you
summary: Care and understanding for employees and families in difficult circumstances.
body: When life takes an unexpected turn, support should be close at hand. Cars24’s Compassionate Support programme helps employees and families navigate difficult personal circumstances.
details: A team to help you find the support available
Care for employees and their families during difficult times
note: Speak privately with your People partner about your circumstances and the current support process.
source: Starter Kit 26, page 22; Slack builders-cars24, 21 September 2026

title: Mission Elevate
eyebrow: Your next move can start here
summary: Opportunities for frontline builders to explore careers across Cars24.
body: Mission Elevate helps frontline team members grow beyond their current roles and explore opportunities across the company. It puts internal mobility alongside learning as a route to taking on a different kind of problem.
details: A pathway for frontline builders to explore their next role
note: Check current openings and eligibility with the People team. Availability depends on the opportunity.
source: Starter Kit 26, page 22; Slack announcements, 6 February 2025

photos.alt: A Mission Elevate recognition event at Cars24

title: Founders’ Awards
eyebrow: Celebrate work that makes a difference
summary: Recognition for builders whose contribution raises the bar.
body: The Founders’ Awards recognise contributions that make a difference at Cars24. The programme makes space to celebrate the people behind the work and the standards they set for others.
details: A chance to celebrate the people behind meaningful work
note: The People team shares the current nomination process, cycle and award details.
